**Design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was that the module didn't check the `en` (enable) signal. It was incrementing the counter on every clock edge regardless of the enable input. I fixed it by adding an `else if (en)` condition so the counter only increments when `en` is high, which matches the spec requirement that "when `en` is low, the count and `gray` hold their values."
